Entry Royal Audience and Homage Entry Royal Audience and Homage When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. They start by asking who is obligated, who is protected, and who will seek justice after a breach of contract.

For them, what really matters is whether the orders can arrive, whether the roads are safe, and whether the food and pay can be received on time.

What is remembered is not who spoke the loudest in the hall, but which rule saved the family from starvation, conscription, or endless fighting.
